stories.title: DMK backs Centre's delimitation bill, says Tamil Nadu's representation will rise from 7.18% to 7.21%
Preparations underway at Thiruparankundram hill for Karthigai Deepam lighting at Deepathoon.
stories.summary: Preparations have commenced for the Karthigai Deepam lighting on Thiruparankundram hill. The Central Reserve Police Force assumes security responsibilities there after a Supreme Court ruling. Devotees are entering the hillside after submitting Aadhaar details and mobile numbers.

stories.title: Kallakurichi TVK MLA Arul Vignesh remanded in 14-day judicial custody, lodged in Cuddalore Central Prison
stories.summary: Kallakurichi Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam MLA C Arul Vignesh was arrested for allegedly harassing a woman IAS officer. Following an investigation, he was taken into custody by the police after a thorough inquiry. Vignesh underwent a medical examination before being presented in court

stories.title: Potholes persist on Medavakkam-Mambakkam Road despite years of complaints
stories.summary: Residents demand repairs to the Medavakkam-Mambakkam stretch, saying even a four-year-old boy’s death in a crash has failed to spur action.
